ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the
B3-3, Community Shopping District symbols as shown on Map No. 10-E in the area
bounded by:

      A line 70 feet south of and parallel to East 45th Street; South Cottage Grove Avenue; A
      line 95 feet south of and parallel to East 45th Street; the public alley next west of and
      parallel to South Cottage Grove Avenue,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          ___________________________
                                                          Lamont J. Robinson
                                                          Alderman, 4th Ward




Common Address:
4508 S. Cottage Grove Avenue
